name: footer-cta
title: Call-to-action footer
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A closing band with one invitation and up to two actions, merged with a compact footer row, in inverse, accent or surface tone.

meta.useWhen: Every page should end by offering the same next step, such as booking or getting in touch.
meta.avoidWhen: The page already ends with a strong call to action, or there is no concrete next step to offer.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/FooterCta.astro. In a Site Boulder site, render it from SiteFooter.astro and pass the existing credit link.
